name: R&D: Tyres & Thermal Management
author: Swofty
description: Adds a new career R&D department, Tyres & Thermal Management, alongside the stock four.

options.label: Render the 5th R&D box
options.description: Inject the Tyres & Thermal Management box into the career R&D > Performance department grid. Experimental; disable if the Performance page misbehaves.

options.label: Attach the Tyres upgrade tree
options.description: Resolve and log the per-save R&D upgrade container the code-4 'fake' Tyres department reads (trees.<engine_supplier>.fake). The Tyres rows ship in the database for every team tree; this read-only hook confirms the container hash on the player's save.

options.label: Diagnose the 5th R&D box layout
options.description: Read-only: on the next R&D > Performance visit, log the department box grid's authored slot vector vs the card vector so the invisible-5th-box cause is captured. Produces no gameplay change.

options.label: Render the 5th development-potential pie slice
options.description: Grow the R&D Performance development-potential pie to a 5th Tyres slice. Highest-risk and experimental: the wedge is authored art, so the slice is built but no wedge draws yet. Default off.

options.label: Diagnose the upgrade-tree tile source count
options.description: Read-only: log the upgrade-tree loader's per-department row count, including the code-4 'fake'/Tyres branch, to bisect the empty-page cause (4 rows = our nodes loaded, blocker is display; 1 row = instancecount bump not honored). No gameplay change.

options.label: Relax the R&D overview selection clamp
options.description: Off by default. Leftover v0.5.0 experiment: lets the R&D overview box grid store selection index 4 (the name read stays guarded). It does not open the Tyres page; instantiate_tyres_upgrades does that.

options.label: Instantiate the Tyres upgrades
options.description: Give the three Tyres & Thermal upgrades real R&D states so the Tyres department page lists them and they can be researched. The stock tree hub stays hidden. Install-time; relaunch after changing.

options.label: Diagnose the R&D page upgrade instances
options.description: Read-only: each time an R&D department page is built, log the team's upgrade-instance count per department (the Tyres page should show 4:3) and the state of every Fake/Tyres instance.

options.label: Fix the Tyres Develop Upgrade screen
options.description: Back from a Tyres upgrade's Develop Upgrade screen returns to the Tyres page (never traps), and the card art and vehicle performance comparison fill in. Install-time; relaunch after turning it off.

options.label: Tyres upgrades cost 5 points (test)
options.description: Temporary test price: the three Tyres & Thermal upgrades cost 5 research points for research and development, standard or rush. Turn off to use the database cost.
